newsitem.title: UK: OPEC basket price fell 81 cts last week to $17.74.
newsitem.headline: OPEC basket price fell 81 cts last week to $17.74.

text.p: The price of OPEC's basket of seven crudes fell to $17.74 per barrel last week from $18.55 the previous week, the OPEC news agency OPECNA said on Monday.
Quoting figures released by the OPEC Secretariat, it said the price so far this year, up to April 3, has averaged $20.54.
In March the basket price averaged $18.64, down from $20.48 in February and $23.19 in January, it said.
The basket comprises Algeria's Saharan Blend, Indonesia's Minas, Nigeria's Bonny Light, Saudi Arabia's Arabian Light, Dubai of the UAE, Venezuela's Tia Juana and Mexico's Isthmus.
